packageRules.description: One weekly pull request for all non-security updates (npm and pnpm, Dockerfile base images, GitHub Actions, the image tools in ci.yml). Security updates are never grouped: they are separate pull requests, raised at any time.

customManagers.description: Docker images that ci.yml runs as containers and pins as name@sha256:digest # version (hadolint, Trivy). The Dockerfile and GitHub Actions managers do not read these.
